approach: Replace the trailer rule in land::pr_commits with content classification. For each commit in remote_base..head (oldest first), build Change::of_commit and Judged::new from athena-gate, then: (1) closing_jobs (made pub in invariant.rs, logic unchanged) non-empty → job_landing, after requiring exactly one job, a verification record and a landed outcome in the commit's tree (JobFiles::load); (2) else if the diff adds records/interventions/<month>/<id>.json with a valid id whose month matches → declared_intervention; (3) else if the tree fingerprint (parent rules) equals the parent's → records_only (covers records and owner-path files); (4) else error naming the sha. PrCommit gains kind and optional job/verification; gh.rs GitLandingRecords::commits copies them into LandingCommit, so job_ids come only from job_landing commits. Fixtures in gh.rs, reconcile.rs and the CLI reconcile test are rewritten to follow the content rules (real closing records, or a records-only owner-path commit) rather than loosening code. run.rs retry_landing is audited and not changed unless it depends on pr_commits; drain.rs does not exist and is not created.

decisions.choice: Reuse athena_gate::invariant::closing_jobs by making it pub; call per commit with Change::of_commit and Judged::new.
decisions.reason: One source of truth for which job's closing records a commit adds, including blocked-job exclusion, so blocked-then-landed works with no new logic.

rejected.option: Re-implement the closing-path scan in land.rs

rejected.why: It checks ordering, invocations and fingerprints already checked at commit time; classification only needs closing_jobs.

decisions.choice: Non-empty closing_jobs means job_landing regardless of fingerprint change; more than one job, missing verification, or no landed outcome is an error naming the sha.
decisions.reason: A LandingCommit carries one job and one verification; unverifiable landings must not be recorded.

rejected.option: Require a fingerprint change for job_landing
rejected.why: An empty-change landed job would be lost as records_only.
Violates the contract that nothing is recorded for unverified commits.

decisions.choice: Verification id from verification_id(job, sha) after confirming JobFiles.verification exists in the commit's tree.
decisions.reason: One verification per job named by the job id; works when verification came from an earlier commit (blocked-then-landed).

rejected.option: Require verification added by the same commit

decisions.choice: Recognise declared intervention by an added path records/interventions/<month>/<id>.json with valid RecordId and matching month; read no trailer.
decisions.reason: Content-based, same path rule as the gate.

rejected.why: Request is to stop reading trailers.

decisions.choice: Update fixtures (gh.rs, reconcile.rs via a cfg(test) pub(crate) helper in land.rs; CLI test uses a records-only owner-notes commit with nested .gitattributes in base).
decisions.reason: The code is right to refuse trailer-only commits; the CLI test cannot reach a lib cfg(test) helper and only needs pr_commits to succeed.

rejected.option: Keep trailer-only fixtures with a fallback

decisions.choice: Do not create drain.rs; audit run.rs retry_landing and leave unchanged unless it depends on pr_commits.
decisions.reason: drain.rs is absent; retry_landing writes commits and does not call pr_commits.

rejected.why: It neither reads nor depends on pr_commits.

files.purpose: Make closing_jobs pub with doc noting it is shared with athena-core pr_commits.
Rewrite PrCommit and pr_commits with content classification; new tests and fixture helper; remove trailer-count tests.
GitLandingRecords::commits copies kind/job/verification; update land_pr fixtures, docs, add records-only test.
Test World::pr_head commits a real landed job.
PR commit becomes records-only owner-notes commit with nested exclusion in base.
Describe content-based classification; remove trailer rule.

steps: Make closing_jobs pub in invariant.rs with updated doc; confirm JobFiles, Change, Judged are reachable from athena-core.

Rewrite PrCommit {sha, tree, kind, job, verification} and pr_commits in land.rs per rules 1-4; errors name sha, base, head; empty range stays an error; doc comments state content rules; no trailer reads.
Delete trailer-count tests; add fixture helper and tests: realistic range, blocked-then-landed, four refusals, empty range.
Update gh.rs GitLandingRecords::commits, job_ids, docs, land_pr fixtures; add records-only test.
Update reconcile.rs World::pr_head to commit a landed job via the helper.
Update CLI reconcile test: owner-notes/.gitattributes in base, pr commit adds owner-notes file, no trailer.
Audit run.rs retry_landing; change nothing unless it calls pr_commits; note drain.rs absent.

Run cargo test -p athena-core land::, gh::, full core, cli reconcile, cargo test --locked, clippy, fmt; write change description listing callers/writers with tests, fixtures vs code, and commands run.

risks.risk: Fixture records that do not parse or sit off canonical paths are silently dropped by JobFiles::load.
risks.mitigation: Use well-formed records copied from gate landing_tests constructors, build paths from JobId::dir(), assert JobFiles::load finds the job.

risks.risk: closing_jobs requires exact path and status 'A'.
risks.mitigation: Blocked-then-landed test proves it works from outcome-landed.json alone.
Ranges are PR-sized; uses existing gate plumbing.

risks.risk: Boundary scan bans a word a doc comment might contain.
risks.mitigation: Use owner-notes and describe the pattern without the banned word; run full cargo test --locked.

risks.risk: Other tests reaching pr_commits via land_pr still use trailer-only commits.
risks.mitigation: Grep pr_commits and GitLandingRecords, run whole suite.

demonstrations.method: Unit test: base commits nested owner-notes/.gitattributes '* athena-exclude'; then reading, dispatch, introspection, owner-path file, intervention record, then job candidate/verification/outcome plus governed work, no trailers; call pr_commits.
demonstrations.observes: Kinds are [RecordsOnly x4, DeclaredIntervention, JobLanding]; last has the fixture job and its verification id.
demonstrations.fails_without: With the trailer rule every commit errors; with wrong classification the asserted kinds differ.

demonstrations.method: Unit test: commit 1 adds candidate, verification, blocked outcome; commit 2 adds only outcome-landed.json plus governed file.
demonstrations.observes: Commit 1 RecordsOnly with no job; commit 2 JobLanding for that job with its verification id.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without reusing closing_jobs the blocked commit is not records_only or the outcome-landed-only commit does not map to its job.

demonstrations.method: Four unit tests: governed change with no intervention/closing records; landing without verification; landing whose outcome is not landed; owner-path file without the nested exclusion.
demonstrations.observes: Each pr_commits Err text contains the commit sha.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the refusals these commits classify as records or landings and no error contains the sha.

demonstrations.method: Run full core suite, then separately `cargo test -p athena-cli --test reconcile`.
demonstrations.observes: All pass, including the 5 core reconcile tests and 2 CLI reconcile tests; description states fixtures changed and why.
demonstrations.fails_without: Trailer-only fixtures fail pr_commits, so those 7 tests fail unless fixtures carry real closing records or a records-only commit.

demonstrations.method: land_pr tests with a real landed-job commit and a records-only commit; assert landing.commits kinds/job/verification and validate().unwrap().
demonstrations.observes: LandingCommits match pr_commits output; validate passes; intent.job_ids lists only job_landing jobs.
demonstrations.fails_without: If kind/job/verification were not copied, records-only commits would be JobLanding and fail validate.

demonstrations.method: Trailerless tests plus a pr_commits(base, base) test asserting Err containing 'adds no commit'; read final land.rs doc comments and confirm no trailers()/Athena-Job in pr_commits or PrCommit.
demonstrations.observes: Empty-range error text; doc comments state content rules and closing_jobs as single source; trailer-count tests gone.
demonstrations.fails_without: A leftover trailer read makes the trailerless tests error; dropping the empty-range error fails the empty-range test.

demonstrations.method: Compare the change description against grep-found callers: gh.rs GitLandingRecords::commits/intent/landing/write_landing, reconcile.rs via write_landing, athena-cli reconcile tests, run.rs retry_landing (audited), drain.rs (absent).
demonstrations.observes: Each caller/writer listed with its covering test; cargo commands actually run cited with results.

demonstrations.method: Read the diffs of docs/design/records-history.md and CHANGELOG.md.
demonstrations.observes: Content-based classification and closing_jobs described; the 'exactly one Athena-Job trailer' rule is gone; CHANGELOG entry under unreleased.

demonstrations.method: Run clippy with warnings denied, then separately `cargo fmt --all --check`.
demonstrations.observes: Both exit 0 with no warnings or diffs, including the new tests and the pub closing_jobs.
demonstrations.fails_without: A lint in the new classification code or tests (unused field, needless clone, unused import after trailer removal) makes clippy exit non-zero; unformatted code makes fmt --check exit non-zero.

open_questions: drain.rs does not exist in the base snapshot though listed as a deliverable; plan does not create it. Confirm acceptable.
Whether a nested .gitattributes added in the same commit as an owner-path file counts as excluded; classification uses parent rules, so fixtures commit it in the base.
Merge commits in range (first-parent diff) are not covered by the brief; add a case if cheap.
A commit adding only a candidate with no outcome is refused; revisit if Athena writes candidates separately.
